name: Sun Cleric: Solar Conduit cuts Dawnsear's cast time by 20% while Dawn is active, and Dawn still picks Sunrise or Sunset once (#1562)
contract: #1562. Solar Conduit 300321 (Piety talent, CharacterAdvancement 30311): 'Reduces the cast time of Dawnsear by $s1% while Dawn is active.' Its only effect is ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), MiscValue 12 = SPELLMOD_EFFECT2, BasePoints -21 + DieSides 1 = -20, EffectSpellClassMask (0x40, 0, 0), which in family 33 matches only Dawn 807440 (SpellFamilyFlags word 0 = 0x40). Dawn's own effect 1 is ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108), MiscValue 10 = SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME, amount 0 (BasePoints -1 + DieSides 1), mask (0, 2, 0) = Dawnsear 500146's SpellFamilyFlags word 1. So the authored chain is: Solar Conduit sets Dawn's effect-1 amount to -20, and Dawn's aura then shortens Dawnsear's 3500 ms cast (SpellCastTimes 22) to 2800 ms for as long as Dawn exists; without the talent Dawn's modifier is 0 and changes nothing. Dawn is armed through its real cast, Dawn 804584 with 20 Solar Power. Sunrise and Sunset 92135 (Piety) keeps its behavior: the first Holy or Fire cast after Dawn is armed picks the buff for that school (Fire Dawnsear -> Sunset 500511, Holy Sunflare 800231 -> Sunrise 500477, removing the other), once per Dawn; a later cast of the other school under the same Dawn does not switch it, and a new Dawn arms the choice again. A control cleric without Solar Conduit arms Dawn the same way.
